placement.rationale: Mid-cap placement balances the complete source-sized fractions beside letters and mixed-height figures. Top alignment lowers the denominators; bottom alignment raises the numerators beyond the existing Windows ascent. Center placement fits the existing metrics and retains all source differences.
placement.historical_limit: The charts do not establish a co-set historical text baseline. Row center 350 and 35-unit sidebearings are explicit modern layout choices. Full source physical dimensions and between-form differences remain.
placement.source_gap: Seek matching 8pt fractions or symbols co-set with letters or ordinary figures to establish historical baseline placement.

row_review.note: All three selected native rows were reviewed with top, center and bottom overlays. Fits use only fractions, at threshold 150 except LOC 170; shorter cent and percent retain native positions under the same transform.

regular-fraction-8-atf-handy-1897-0.method: Estimate row skew from whole-form ink-box centers at threshold 150, or 170 for the faint LOC impression. Every row fit excludes the shorter cent/percent. All available traced fractions determine the row fit; their exact IDs and count are recorded. Use one row translation, preserving differences between forms. This is not a measured text baseline.

atf-handy-1897.method: Independent common-capital and repeated-footer physical scale.

atf-new-york-1897.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

atf-handy-byu-1897.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

atf-american-line-1906.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

atf-desk-1898.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

common_capital_fit.method: One isotropic least-squares fit to common capitals after measured row rotation; independent repeated footer transfers scale to fraction chart. Wider10/12pt S forms remain comparison-only and do not set scale.

footer_scale_transfer.method: Map 26 footer projection groups using threshold 170, combining the overlapping R/S pair in FOUNDERS. Measure ink bounds independently at five thresholds. Fit one isotropic 2D similarity transform to matched group centers. No fraction dimensions enter the fit.

quality_decisions: All 305 threshold trials across 55 whole impressions were reviewed on 22 PDF pages; 66 native cells from six books were also reviewed.
BYU threshold 150 supplies complete quarter, half, three-quarters, one-third, one-eighth, cent and percent at the largest available native resolution.
LOC threshold 170 three-eighths retains four complete parts and both counters. Other whole witnesses bridge one or both slash ends.
New York threshold 136 seven-eighths retains four complete parts and both counters within the 132–140 window. Threshold 130 breaks the seven; 150 joins the parts.
Two-thirds and five-eighths remain source-quality gaps. Every available whole impression has a broken stroke or a slash/figure contact at usable thresholds; no parts are assembled or redrawn.
One isotropic scale per book preserves complete physical dimensions. No enclosed holes are filled.
identity_limit: Matched construction and proportional dimensions support grouping; identical historical punches or matrices are not established.

source_quality_gaps.⅔: Eight-point whole impressions retain slash/figure contacts at usable thresholds. NY lower thresholds break numerator or denominator; BYU numerator also has a pale notch. LOC176 still breaks the denominator and177already joins lower slash/numerator. No intact four-part whole witness selected.
source_quality_gaps.⅝: Eight-point Handy and BYU merge both slash ends. New York joins the upper slash to the eight at usable thresholds. American Line has a broken five until the slash ends join. The LOC upper counter remains open through threshold 174 and closes only after a slash contact forms. Seek an intact same-size whole impression.
